Titles.jpn: 劇場版アイカツスターズ

Summaries.eng: In order to organize a "Legendary Dress" contest based on a southern island folktale, the director Hikaru asks all the students and teachers of the Yotsuboshi Gakuen to travel to said island. Little did he know events wouldn't unfold as he planned.
Summaries.jpn: 「伝説のドレス」を求めて南の島へ旅立つ四世学園の生徒たち。
